sections.title: Recommended Gear
paragraphs: Proper footwear, equipment, and clothing will help protect you in The Narrows. You should also bring water, food, and basics like first aid. Check the Narrows Safety page for a full list of recommended gear.
Proper Footwear: Sandals, crocs, or bare feet are not appropriate and often result in twisted ankles or crushed toes. Wear closed-toe shoes or boots.
Hiking Stick / Pole: The Narrows is wet and slippery. A stick/pole is recommended for balance.
Drysuit / Waders: For parts of the year, The Narrows can be quite cold. Many visitors will bring suits/waders to stay warm.

sections.title: Safety
paragraphs: The Virgin River Narrows is extremely beautiful, but it is challenging. At least 60% of the hike is spent wading, walking, and sometimes swimming in the river. The water is cold and fast-flowing, and the riverbed is mostly large, slippery boulders. Even on short trips, this hike can be challenging and risky.

Before your hike, always check the weather and flash flood potential. Flash floods can happen at any time, and your safety is your responsibility. Visit our Narrows Safety page for information about flash floods, cyanobacteria, and other potential hazards.
The Narrows is a strenuous trail that requires proper planning and equipment. Learn about flash floods, cyanobacteria, and more.
